svg.title: Behringer MODEL D connections
svg.desc: Connection inventory. Arrows indicate signal direction relative to the instrument. Locations identify hardware faces; the diagram is not a socket placement drawing. Physical control sections are listed below.
svg.text: Arrows are relative to the device. Locations name the hardware face; sockets are grouped by function.
PHYSICAL CONTROLS / see interface.svg for labelled positions
TOP PATCH CONNECTIONS: Ext audio IN, Osc pitch IN, Osc mod IN, Filter cutoff IN, Filter mod IN, Loudness IN, LFO CV IN, Filter contour gate IN, Loudness contour gate IN, LFO triangle OUT, LFO square
OUT, Filter contour OUT, Loudness contour OUT, Main high OUT, Main low OUT, Phones OUT
CONTROLLERS: Tune, Glide, Mod mix, LFO rate, LFO wave
OSCILLATORS: Osc 1 range, Osc 1 wave, Osc 2 range, Osc 2 freq, Osc 2 wave, Osc 3 range, Osc 3 freq, Osc 3 wave, Osc mod, Osc 3 control
MIXER: Osc 1 level, Osc 2 level, Osc 3 level, Noise level, Ext input, Osc 1 on, Osc 2 on, Osc 3 on, Noise on, Ext on, Noise type
